Look for dt elements with sig class (most structured documentation) dt_blocks = soup.find_all("dt", class_="sig") for block in dt_blocks: sig_name = block.find(class_="sig-name") if sig_name: name = sig_name.get_text(strip=True) if name not in seen: seen.add(name) # Extract description from adjacent dd element desc = "No description found" dd = block.find_next_sibling("dd") if dd: p = dd.find("p") desc = p.get_text(strip=True) if p else dd.get_text(strip=True)[:200] functions.append({ "name": name, "signature": block.get_text(strip=True), "description": desc, "parameters": extract_parameters(block.get_text(strip=True)), }) # 2. def extract_parameters(signature: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]:
    """
    Extract parameter information from a function signature.

    Args:
        signature: Function signature string

    Returns:
        List of parameter dictionaries
    """
    params = []
    match = re.search(r"\((.*?)\)", signature)
    if match:
        param_string = match.group(1)
        if param_string.strip():
            param_parts = [p.strip() for p in param_string.split(",") if p.strip()]
            for part in param_parts:
                # Extract name, handling type annotations and defaults
                name = part.split(":")[0].split("=")[0].strip()
                param_type = "unknown"
                default = None
                
                # Check for type annotation (name: type)
                if ":" in part:
                    type_part = part.split(":")[1].split("=")[0].strip()
                    param_type = type_part if type_part else "unknown"
                
                # Check for default value
                if "=" in part:
                    default = part.split("=")[-1].strip()
                
                # Skip self and cls parameters
                if name and name not in ["self", "cls"]:
                    params.append({
                        "name": name,
                        "type": param_type,
                        "default": default,
                        "description": "",
                    })

    return params
